summary: SK hynix filed a Form 6-K reporting a derivatives-related accounting loss of KRW 3.98 trillion ($3.4 billion) on exchangeable bonds issued April 11, 2023, driven by exercise of exchange rights and higher share price. The loss is non-cash under K-IFRS, with embedded derivatives measured at fair value, offset by gains on disposal of treasury shares upon exchange. The filing is a routine loss disclosure under Korean disclosure rules, not a strategic event, and does not constitute a special situation.
